About Natural Remedies Directory

Our Mission

A research-focused directory of natural remedy protocols, remedies, and conditions sourced from PDFs, videos, forums, and testimonials.

Data Model

This directory organizes natural health information across 10 collections:

  • Suppliers: 2 records
  • Ailments: 63 records
  • References: 5 records
  • Protocols: 3 records
  • Education: 4 records
  • Remedies: 108 records
  • Therapies: 4 records
  • Testimonials: 4 records
  • Practitioners: 3 records
  • Products: 3 records

Evidence Grading

All entries include evidence grades and source attribution. Evidence levels range from A (highest) to F (lowest):

GradeLabelMeaning
AHighStrong evidence from high-quality studies
BModerateModerate evidence, some inconsistency
CLowLimited evidence, suggestive but not definitive
DVery LowVery limited evidence, preliminary findings
EAnecdotalAnecdotal or theoretical evidence only
FDisprovenEvidence shows no effect or harm

Methodology

  • Canonical data is stored in data/canonical/json/
  • Search indices are built via scripts/build_search_index.py
  • Website is generated via website/scripts/generate_site.py
  • Data validation runs via scripts/validate_data.py

Research directory – not medical advice. Always consult a qualified healthcare provider before making health decisions.
